_notice: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. All addresses and leaves are dummy placeholders. Replace and verify source capacity calldata, accepted leaf masks, live configuration and economic limits. No typed liquidity executor is used. Grant required account leaf roles only to RecipeExecutor; the provider receives execute access. A leaf role granted directly to the provider bypasses recipe limits. The script resolves adapter.account() and the collateral underlying through the policy's pinned request factory and facility from the selected RPC and encodes proposed configuration; it does not deploy, sign or broadcast. Use a ThreeFPolicy implementation deployed with its trusted requestsFactory and facility, then create the policy through its MigratablesFactory with create(version, curator, abi.encode(account)). The policy validates request provenance and resolves the collateral underlying used for its period budget and minimum yield; charged amounts remain in funding-token units. The guarded mint requires the account as the policy's sole consumer; direct managers and executors using that leaf share its budget. Budget and minimum are independent of the account Merkle root, but the guarded mint leaf that charges them is not: the builder derives mintLeafHash from mintLeafData and mintLeafMask and commits that same hash in the recipe; publish the generated leaf and its roles with the recipe. Existing leaves.mint input is ignored. A guarded mint leaf role granted directly to a curator still enforces the policy. To use native mint leaves without a guarded capability, set policy.guardedMint to false and provide executor at the top level; the executor consumes the policy through Call and checks exact cash, principal and yield deltas. Restrict native mint leaf roles to that executor. Regenerate existing 3F leaves and recipes because consume now takes the request address. Reconcile existing funding-key limits and usage explicitly when migrating to collateral-underlying keys.
